name: City Streets & Market
description: Cobbled town district with shopfronts, market stalls and narrow alleys.
palette: grey cobble, painted shutters, canvas awning cream, soot-stained plaster
lighting: bright overcast daylight, deep shade in the alleys, lantern warmth in doorways
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, flat orthographic projection with every object drawn as its top surface and a short soft shadow cast beside it on the floor, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: grey cobblestone paving worn smooth down the middle, gutters running with rainwater
materials: A fantasy city district seen from above. Cobbled streets worn smooth down their centres with open gutters at the sides, timber and plaster buildings with stone foundations, market stalls, stacked crates and barrels, a handcart and a loaded wagon, painted signboards, iron street lamps, a stone fountain basin, and open cobbled paving.
boundary: open street and square carrying off the edges of the map
